title: Japan Ke 3 Paise Wale Tarike
note:
THE RECAP AND THE CLOSE. B is held across all four recap frames, and each
     one carries its own chapter's mark redrawn small in the plate: the buy/skip
     fork from 4.10, the eight-and-two cells from 5.2-5.4, the four rows with
     the second one lit from 6.10, and the shared square from 7.4. Holding the
     layout is what makes them read as one list; the marks are what make each
     one a different frame. A recap is the one place in a cut where repeating a
     drawn device is the point rather than the failure.

     Ground arc: warm -> green -> green deeper -> amber on the one that governs
     the other three -> green for tonight -> neutral for the whole video ->
     the single pop frame -> warm out.

     Archetypes: B B B B A A D A. Nothing is drawn after s88: the last four
     frames are one page, one pen and a closed diary, and every one of them is
     already the picture.
